summary: Iteration 51 — Verified Dashboard RBAC enforcement (permissions.dashboard='none' blocks both backend access and UI visibility). Backend pytest 3/3 PASS. Frontend Playwright validated admin shows dashboard, NoDash user is redirected to /companies on login and on direct /dashboard URL, sidebar 'İdarə Paneli' is hidden along with its separator. Found and fixed one race-condition bug in Dashboard.jsx that was causing logout instead of RBAC redirect on initial dashboard fetch 403.

ui_bugs.issue: Race condition: On first render permsLoading=true, so the early-return guard at line 129 (!permsLoading && …) does NOT trigger. fetchStats then proceeds to call GET /api/dashboard/stats. Backend correctly returns 403 for a user with dashboard='none'. The catch-block treated 401 and 403 identically — removed the token and navigated to /login — effectively logging out the user instead of letting the RBAC redirect useEffect (lines 93-119) take them to the first allowed module. Result: NoDash users would be bounced back to /login on every load.
ui_bugs.fix_applied_by_test_agent: Split 401 vs 403 handling: only 401 clears token + redirects to /login. 403 sets stats={} and returns silently so the RBAC redirect effect can navigate to /companies. After fix, NoDash user lands on /companies within ~1s without being logged out.

Backend GET /api/dashboard/stats — user with role.permissions.dashboard='read' → 200 + valid stats JSON
Frontend admin login → lands on /dashboard, 'İdarə Paneli' visible in sidebar, 4 stat-card data-testid elements render
Frontend NoDash user login → redirected from /dashboard to /companies within 1s (no /login bounce after fix)

Frontend direct /dashboard URL by NoDash user → redirected to /companies within 0.5s, no spinner stuck, no infinite loop
action_items: Review and confirm the fix applied to /app/frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.jsx (lines 139-150) — splitting 401 vs 403 handling. The fix is minimal and correctly preserves the RBAC redirect flow without logging the user out. Main agent should keep this change.

Optional: To eliminate the brief 403 console error during initial render, gate fetchStats to wait for permsLoading to be false. Currently the API is called before permissions arrive because the early-return at line 129 requires !permsLoading. Suggestion: change to 'if (permsLoading) return;' at the top of fetchStats so we never call /dashboard/stats before knowing the user's permission. This would be a UX polish (no 403 in console) but is not blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:487 — get_dashboard_stats correctly uses Depends(check_permission('dashboard', 'read')). Returns 403 with 'Bu əməliyyat üçün icazəniz yoxdur' for users whose role.permissions.dashboard is not 'read'/'write' (verified for value 'none').
Sidebar.jsx:347-357 — Dashboard link + separator wrapped in canView(permissions, 'dashboard') fragment. When false, both elements are hidden — no orphan divider. ✓
Dashboard.jsx:93-119 — Fallback order is reasonable (companies first). useEffect dependencies are correct: re-runs when permissions resolve.

Dashboard.jsx fetchStats race condition (FIXED in this iteration): Previously called API while permsLoading=true; backend 403 was misinterpreted as expired-token and logged out the user. Fixed by treating 403 as 'no permission, let RBAC effect redirect' instead of clearing token.

Recommendation for future hardening: also gate fetchStats with 'if (permsLoading) return;' so we never even attempt the API call when we already know we won't have access — eliminates one network round-trip and a console error per page load.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 51 verified the dashboard RBAC bug fix end-to-end. Backend already enforces 403 via check_permission('dashboard','read'). Frontend Sidebar correctly hides İdarə Paneli + separator. Frontend Dashboard.jsx had a residual bug where the initial fetchStats call (made before permissions loaded due to the race) returned 403 and was treated as a logout trigger — fixed by splitting 401/403 handling. The RBAC redirect effect (Dashboard.jsx:93-119) takes the user to /companies (first allowed module). Admin/NoDash/DashRead users all verified at backend and frontend. NOTE: a minor 'GET 403' console error still appears once during initial load for nodash users — harmless because the redirect effect immediately navigates away, but could be eliminated by adding 'if (permsLoading) return;' at the top of fetchStats.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: when role.permissions.dashboard='none', user could still access dashboard. Fix made by main agent: (a) backend gated /api/dashboard/stats with check_permission('dashboard','read'); (b) frontend Sidebar wrapped dashboard link+separator in canView gate; (c) frontend Dashboard page added RBAC redirect useEffect and a fetch-skip guard. Residual issue discovered by testing agent: the fetch-skip guard requires !permsLoading, but on first render permsLoading is true, so fetchStats still hit the API, got 403, and the catch-block treated 401 and 403 identically — clearing the token and bouncing to /login. After splitting 401 (real auth failure → /login) from 403 (no permission → let RBAC effect redirect), the flow works: NoDash users land on /companies as intended.
